purpose: Engineering-only identity retrieval diagnostic for the working UC3 dense retrieval configuration.
source_basis: Queries and expected document identities are derived only from pre-existing canonical title and reference metadata in corpus/use_cases/UC3/source_selection.tsv and corpus/use_cases/UC3/eligibility_review.tsv.
PROBE_COUNT_ADAPTATION: prospectively adapted from 8 to 9 because UC3 has 9 accepted documents
methodological_note: The UC1 core identity-diagnostic design is preserved (top-k, repeats, ranking unit, expected-document measure, and benchmark separation), while probe count is prospectively adapted for complete UC3 document coverage.
interpretation: This protocol tests real-corpus retrieval identity and execution integrity for UC3. It is not by itself an embedding-model acceptance test.

execution.expected_document_measure: rank of the first retrieved chunk belonging to the expected document
